decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 25 May 2006, the demolition of existing rear extension and erection of single storey side and rear extensions and the erection of a rear dormer roof extension incorporating the installation of two roof lights to the front elevation, as shown on drawing number GS/DR/01, received 25 May 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of the demolition of existing rear extension and erection of single storey side and rear extensions and the erection of a rear dormer roof extension incorporating the installation of two roof lights to the front elevation, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A, Class B and class C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of existing rear extension and erection of single storey rear extension incorporating rooflights and erection of roof extension to house
